title: Understanding Clusters
text: Clusters are groups of similar data points. When you have a cluster number as a feature, it represents a categorical variable.

title: Handling Categorical Variables
text: Categorical variables often need to be transformed into a numerical format that a model can understand. One common method is one-hot encoding.

title: Why One-Hot Encode?
text: One-hot encoding transforms categorical variables into a format that can be provided to ML algorithms to do a better job in prediction.

title: Final Decision
text: To prepare the cluster column for model training, you should one-hot encode it to ensure the model treats each cluster as a separate category.
